'''Pokémon Puppet Theater: Puppemon''' (Japanese: '''ポケモンパペット劇場 パぺモン''' ''Pokémon Puppet Gekijō: Papemon'') is a puppet show released as a web-series by the [[Pokémon Daisuki Club]]. It is coproduced by FEVER creations and NICKEN and episodes release biweekly on the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel. The series has 30 episodes as of January 23rd, 2018.
